title: Where did I put my water bottle?
scene: 水壶不知放哪了，问爸爸看见没。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Where did I put my water bottle?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Did you see it in the car?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: I think so, on the seat.

variations: "water bottle" 换 "jacket"；"in the car" 换 "by the door"。
